### Labor Market & Career Analytics

**Big Data & Cloud Analytics · Boston University**

Analyzed large-scale job posting data to evaluate career pathways, occupational demand, salary trends, and skill requirements in the analytics job market.

<div class="project-insights">

<strong>Key findings:</strong>

<ul>
<li>Analyzed <strong>287 job postings</strong> in the Computer Systems Design industry.</li>
<li>Salary information was available for <strong>39%</strong> of postings.</li>
<li>The overall median salary midpoint identified in the dataset was <strong>$150,708</strong>.</li>
<li>Data Scientist and Database Architect roles showed the strongest salary potential in the sample.</li>
</ul>

### Monthly Sales Trend Analysis

**Python & SQL for Business Analytics**

Analyzed Northwind Traders sales data using SQL and Python to calculate monthly revenue, measure month-over-month growth, and identify periods of significant increases and declines.

<div class="project-insights">

<strong>Key findings:</strong>

<ul>
<li>Sales fluctuated significantly from month to month rather than following a consistent upward or downward trend.</li>
<li>August 2012 recorded a <strong>72.14% month-over-month increase</strong>.</li>
<li>July 2013 reached approximately <strong>$4.28M in monthly sales</strong>, followed by a <strong>30.11% decline</strong> in August.</li>
<li>The analysis demonstrated how SQL window functions and Python visualization can support forecasting and business planning.</li>
</ul>

</div>
